ui.legend: Topo quality is measured from important basic information (for example images). Extra information that is not always available adds bonus points (for example first ascents and videos).
ui.scoreHint:
The percent is the required points of this spot and everything inside it, divided by the maximum.

A drawn line is 2 points. A line style is 5. A portrait image is 10. A description on a crag, sector or area is 5. GPS on a topo image is 10, GPS on a spot is 8, parking is 8, and descriptions covering 20% of the lines in an area are 2 points per slot.

A video is 3 bonus points. A first ascentionist with a date is 3 bonus points. Bonus points sit beside the bar and do not change the percent.

Projects do not need a line style to reach 100% topo quality. Videos and first ascents on projects award no points. If a parent spot has parking, spots inside it do not need parking to reach 100% topo quality.

A spot with nothing to score is Platin.
ui.checkHint.lineDrawn: 2 points for every published line that is drawn on at least one topo image.
ui.checkHint.lineStyle: 5 points for every published line with at least one line style, such as slab, roof or crack. Projects do not need a style to reach 100% topo quality.
ui.checkHint.spotImage: 10 points for every crag, sector and area that has a portrait image.
ui.checkHint.topoGps: 10 points for every published topo image that has GPS coordinates.
ui.checkHint.spotGps: 8 points for every crag, sector and area that has a position on the map.
ui.checkHint.spotParking: 8 points for every crag, sector and area that has a parking marker. If a parent spot has parking, spots inside it do not need their own parking to reach 100% topo quality.
ui.checkHint.spotDescription: 5 points for every crag, sector and area that has a description.
ui.checkHint.lineDescriptions: 2 points for each description needed to cover 20% of the published lines in an area, rounded up. Further descriptions do not add points.
ui.checkHint.lineVideo: 3 bonus points for every published line with a video. This is not required to reach 100% topo quality. Projects do not award these points.
ui.checkHint.lineFa: 3 bonus points for every published line with a first ascentionist and a date or year. This is not required to reach 100% topo quality. Projects do not award these points.
